provenance.reasoning: Connectivity repair wired this option to a factor another option targets; no effect value is implied

provenance.basis: A £10/month increase is provisionally assumed to raise monthly churn by 0.5 percentage points through lower willingness to pay.
With 3% monthly churn, one subscriber today contributes about 0.97^12 subscribers at month 12.
Near the stated 3% monthly churn baseline, a one-percentage-point increase is provisionally estimated to reduce the month-12 stock by about 43 subscribers.
